星系熔炉现已全面武装并投入运行。随着虫洞通道完工，我们已取得通往围绕星系核心六个集结星系的通道。

我们开始进行核心过热工作。其它帝国可能察觉并试图进入这些恒星系，但暂时我们占有优势，核心已屈服于我们的意志。

使用虫洞保护星系核心恒星系

我们开始进行核心过热工作。其它帝国可能察觉并试图进入这些恒星系，但暂时我们占有优势，核心已屈服于我们的意志。

texts.en:
The Galactic Crucible is now fully armed and operational. With wormhole tunnels completed, we've secured access to all six staging systems around the Galactic Core.

Our work to overheat the Core can begin. Other empires may detect our activity and attempt to reach these systems, but for now, we hold the advantage, and the core bends to our will.

Use the wormhole to secure the Galactic Core systems

label.zh: 开始在核心恒星系中部署。
label.en: Begin installation in the core systems.

tooltips.zh: 在六个星系核心恒星系中部署导管群，我们就能一次性使整个星系过热。必须着手准备。
tooltips.en: Deploying Conduits in the six Galactic Core systems will let us overheat the entire galaxy at once. We must begin preparations.

label.zh: 我们的未来因火焰而光明。
label.en: Our future is bright with fire.

tooltips.zh: 在六个星系核心恒星系中部署导管群，我们就能一次性使整个星系过热。必须着手准备。
tooltips.en: Deploying Conduits in the six Galactic Core systems will let us overheat the entire galaxy at once. We must begin preparations.

texts.zh:
我们对结晶熵的掌控即将开启星系激变。已开通连接星系核心6个恒星系的虫洞。
若在各恒星系建立导管群设施，并守护免受干涉，我们即可燃烧整个星系。
texts.en:
Our mastery of Crystallized Entropy will soon allow us to begin a radical transformation of the galaxy. We have opened wormholes to six systems around the galactic core.
If we establish Conduits in each of these, and defend them from anyone who would meddle with our plans, we will be able to set the galaxy itself ablaze.

texts.zh:
我们憧憬着火焰乌托邦，为达成愿景必须清除一切阻碍。第一束火光已升起，必须助长其燃烧，让烈焰蔓延至星系的每一个角落。

夺取的核心恒星系：[event_target:hyperthermia_empire.gh_crisis_core_var]
texts.en:
We envision a blazing utopia, but to create it we must incinerate everything that stands in our way. We've lit the first sparks, and must now stoke the flames until every corner of the galaxy has been consumed.

Captured Core Systems: [event_target:hyperthermia_empire.gh_crisis_core_var]

texts.zh:
[event_target:hyperthermia_empire.GetName]点燃群星，迎战星系最炽烈的火焰，只有一次机会，如果失败，一切都将化为灰烬。

夺取的核心恒星系：[event_target:hyperthermia_empire.gh_crisis_core_var]
texts.en:
[event_target:hyperthermia_empire.GetName] has set the stars ablaze. It is now our turn to fight the greatest fire the galaxy has ever faced. There are no second chances. If we fail, everything we have achieved will be reduced to ash.

Captured Core Systems: [event_target:hyperthermia_empire.gh_crisis_core_var]

sections.zh:
导管群占领的星系核心恒星系数量决定每月进度。

    —少于3个：-3
    —占领3个：0
    —多于3个：+3

当前进度
sections.en:
The amount of Galactic Core systems occupied by Conduits determines the monthly progression. 

    - Less than 3 systems: -3 
    - Occupying 3 systems: 0 
    - More than 3 systems: +3 

Current Progress

texts.zh:
当我们忙于引燃星系时，[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]已经将其永久重塑，把恒星变为了武器。

现在，我们终于可以拥抱新的乌托邦，但随着他们对银河控制的加深，我们应密切监视他们的下一步行动。
texts.en:
While we were busy igniting the spark that would set the galaxy ablaze, the [hyperthermia_empire.GetName] had already transformed stars into weapons, reshaping the galaxy forever. 

For now, we can embrace this newly forged utopia, but we should closely monitor their next moves as they tighten their grip on the galaxy.

texts.zh:
火风暴即将爆发。星系核心将喷发，铲除敌人并确立我们对群星的统治。

然而星系拒绝接纳我们辉煌未来。通过新开超空间航路，他们密谋入侵集结地，颠覆我们的一切。目的何在？仅为守护那阴冷停滞的黑暗？

我们绝不能允许。必须坚守核心线，直至火风暴点燃，将他们化为灰烬。
texts.en:
A cascading firestorm impends. Soon, the galactic core will erupt, cleansing our enemies and cementing our dominion over the stars.

But the galaxy refuses to embrace our radiant future. Through the newly-forged hyperlanes, they plot to invade our staging grounds and undo everything we've built. For what? To preserve their cold, stagnant darkness?

We cannot allow them to interfere. We must hold the line at the core, until the firestorm ignites and reduces them to ash.

texts.zh:
星系核心持续升温，[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]的纵火狂热助推火势。按此速度，火风暴将消灭所有反对者，几乎灭绝星系所有生命。

不可沟通妥协。若想生存，必须攻破源头：星系核心恒星系，那里火力最旺。唯有如此，[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]方能阻止。

整个星系的命运悬于一线。是时候告诉[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]，玩火者……必将自食其果。
texts.en:
The galactic core grows ever hotter, driven by [hyperthermia_empire.GetName]'s fanatical obsession with igniting the stars. At this pace, their firestorm will annihilate all opposition, and purge the galaxy of nearly all life.

They cannot be reasoned with. If we are to survive, we must strike at the source: the Galactic Core systems, where their power burns brightest. Only then can [hyperthermia_empire.GetName] be stopped.

The fate of the entire galaxy hangs in the balance. It's time to show [hyperthermia_empire.GetName] that those who play with fire... will burn.

tooltips.zh: 必须控制六大核心恒星系才能获胜。
tooltips.en: We must maintain control of the six core systems to achieve victory.

tooltips.zh: 必须控制六大核心恒星系才能获胜。
tooltips.en: We must maintain control of the six core systems to achieve victory.

texts.zh:
从星系核心到最外围的恒星，我们煽起了胜利火焰。火风暴已将敌人烧成灰烬。他们缺乏勇气与远见，无法拥抱我们所缔造的辉煌未来。星系属于我们。

在这火与怒的新秩序里，行星被岩浆与光芒熔煮，由红巨星的火焰温度点亮。熵能涌流穿梭于每一恒星系，由我们采集、塑造。帝国日益富裕强盛……不可阻挡。

我们吞噬并重塑星系，成为虚空中熊熊燃烧的统治灯塔。或许有朝一日，我们还将引燃其他星系。
texts.en:
We have fanned the flames of victory from the galactic core to the outermost stars. The firestorm has reduced our enemies to ash. They lacked the vision, the courage, to embrace the glorious future we claimed. The galaxy is ours.

In this new order of fire and fury, planets boil with magma and light, set aglow by the swelling heat of red giants. Entropy surges through every system, ours to harvest and bend to our will. With each passing day, our empire grows richer, stronger... unstoppable.

We have consumed the galaxy and remade it as a blazing beacon of our dominion in the void. And one day, perhaps, we'll cast other galaxies onto the pyre.

label.zh: 这片新星系，我们志在必得。
label.en: This new galaxy is ours for the taking.

label.zh: 终将所有火焰融为一体。
label.en: In the end, all fires join to become one.

label.zh: 我们的火热母星不容弱者拖累。
label.en: Our fiery home needs no tepid weaklings.
Our endurance has finally been rewarded.

label.zh: 终于，我们将寒冷与黑暗驱逐出星系。
label.en: At last, we've banished the cold dark from this galaxy.

label.zh: 最终，我们可怜的对手化为灰烬。
label.en: At last, our miserable rivals are reduced to ash.

texts.zh:
历史上伟大变革常伴随牺牲。然而，星海共同体将我方的工作视为不必要的威胁，并以联合军事同盟名义对我们动员。

其目标直指灭绝，我们别无选择：任何接近星系核心或星系熔炉的行为都会遭到压倒性武力的回应。

我们的愿景已点燃恒星。让反对者迎战我们召唤的风暴吧。

守住星系核心恒星系，我们就一定能取得胜利！
texts.en:
History's greatest transformations have always demanded sacrifice. Yet the Galactic Community views our work as a threat rather than a necessity. In response, a unified military coalition has mobilized against us.

With extermination their stated goal, we are left with no alternative: any approach toward the Galactic Core or the Galactic Crucible will be met with overwhelming force.

Our vision has ignited the stars themselves. Let those who oppose it contend with the storm we have summoned.

Defend the Galactic Core systems and our victory is assured!

texts.zh:
鉴于星系核心局势升级威胁，星海共同体联合采取行动反对[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]，其激进加热星系行为威胁所有已知生命。

若任其为所欲为，无数文明将陷灭绝危机。所谓[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]已与必要联合的联盟成直接对立。

战斗已发动，数万亿生命岌岌可危。

夺取星系核心恒星系，否则将失去一切！
texts.en:
In light of escalating threats at the galactic core, the Galactic Community has enacted a unified response against [hyperthermia_empire.GetName], whose radical efforts to raise the galactic temperature endanger all known life.

Should these ambitions proceed unchecked, countless civilizations face extinction. The so-called [hyperthermia_empire.GetName] now stands in direct opposition to a coalition united by necessity.

The battle has begun, and trillions of lives hang in the balance.

Capture the Galactic Core systems or all will be lost!

texts.zh:
对立帝国已强行开启通往我们靠近星系核心集结地的超空间航路。随着我们持续使核心超热，必须为抵抗做好准备。

但我们不会被阻止。宇宙中寒冷黑暗将被驱散，取而代之的是我们崛起未来的炽热辉煌。
texts.en:
Rival empires have forced open hyperlanes to our staging grounds near the galactic core. As we continue to superheat the core, we must prepare for resistance.

But we will not be stopped. The cold dark of space will be scoured away, replaced by the blazing glory of our ascendant future.

label.zh: 他们永远无法扑灭我们。
label.en: They will never snuff us out.

label.zh: 让他们前赴后继于熊熊烈焰中吧。
label.en: Let them hurl themselves into our incinerating blaze.

texts.zh:
星系核心开始躁动。环绕超大质量黑洞的熵水平激增，向附近恒星系释放出热辐射波动。

正当恐慌蔓延时，一支由多星球勇敢科学家组成的小组揭示了连接核心周边六个恒星系的新近超空间航路。这些恒星系据悉拥有由[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]运作的设施，正在积极使核心过热。这种鲁莽干预将引发星系级火风暴，将毁灭所有未能阻止纵火狂野心的人。

若想生存，我们必须突破这些恒星系，夺取控制权。危机已至——温度仍在攀升。
texts.en:
The galactic core has begun to stir. Entropy levels around the supermassive black hole are spiking, casting waves of thermal radiation into nearby systems.

Just as panic sets in, a team of brave scientists, drawn from many worlds, has unveiled newly-formed hyperlanes connecting to six systems encircling the core. These systems, it seems, house facilities operated by [hyperthermia_empire.GetName], which are actively superheating the core. This reckless tampering threatens to ignite a cascading firestorm across the galaxy, incinerating all who fail to stop their pyromaniac ambitions.

If we wish to survive, we must breach these systems and wrest control from their grasp. The crisis is here - and the temperature is still rising.

tooltips.zh:
一场无与伦比的危机即将席卷我们的星系。唯有新成立联盟的联合力量才能拯救我们。

将组成反对危机的联盟帝国，引发星系范围冲突。我们将对[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]宣战。
tooltips.en:
A crisis of unparalleled proportions is about to engulf our galaxy. Only the combined strength of a newly formed alliance can save us. 

Will form a coalition of empires opposing the crisis, resulting in a galaxy-wide conflict. We will declare war against the [hyperthermia_empire.GetName].

tooltips.zh: 危机时刻，每个物种都应该自救。我们拥有独立解决的能力。
tooltips.en: In times of crisis, it is every species for themselves. We have the strength to resolve this on our own.

tooltips.zh: [hyperthermia_empire.GetName]的方法符合我们新星系的愿景。契合于此，我们或可幸免于看似灾难的全力冲击。
tooltips.en: The methods of [hyperthermia_empire.GetName] conform to our vision of a renewed galaxy. In light of this alignment, we may be spared the full force of what others will deem a catastrophe.

tooltips.zh: 玩火的帝国司空见惯。此动荡终将过去，置身事外就好了。
tooltips.en: An empire playing with fire is hardly a novelty. This upheaval will pass, as all things do. There is little reason to involve ourselves.
